newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bahia cocoa arrivals reach 2.75 mln bags by Feb 16.
newsitem.headline: Bahia cocoa arrivals reach 2.75 mln bags by Feb 16.

text.p: Bahia 1996/97 cocoa arrivals totalled 2,752,638 million 60-kg bags by February 16 compared with 2,490,880 bags by the corresponding period last year, the Brazilian Trade Commission Comcauba said.
Arrivals during the two-week period to February 16 totalled 38,101 bags compared with 111,841 bags in 1996.
Normally Comcauba issues results on a weekly basis but it combined the two weeks because of the Carnival holiday last week, a Comcauba official said.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
